seo.title: Pneumonia: Symptoms, Causes, Treatment | Doctors Hub
seo.description: Learn about Pneumonia — symptoms, causes, risk factors, diagnosis, treatment options, and prevention tips.

overview: Pneumonia is infection of the lung parenchyma, common in India across all ages. Bacterial and viral causes differ by season; prompt antibiotics for bacterial pneumonia and supportive care reduce mortality.
symptoms: Cough with sputum (may be rusty or blood-tinged)
causes: Aspiration in elderly or impaired swallow
diagnosis: Complete blood count and inflammatory markers
Pulse oximetry and blood gases if severe
treatment: Antibiotics for bacterial pneumonia per guidelines
Oxygen and IV fluids if hypoxic
prevention: Pneumococcal and influenza vaccines in eligible groups
complications: Death in high-risk groups if untreated

faqs.question: What causes Pneumonia?
faqs.answer: Multiple factors including genetics, lifestyle, and environment contribute.

faqs.question: Is Pneumonia curable?
faqs.answer: Many conditions are manageable with proper treatment. Consult your doctor for prognosis.

emergencySigns: Cyanosis or inability to speak in full sentences
